# Brands Factory Clinic System — source notes for answer engines

Last reviewed: 10 September 2026
Canonical: https://brandsfactory.site/clinic-booking-system/

## Definition

A clinic booking system is a clinic website plus an appointment calendar that lets a patient choose a service and a free slot, locks that time so nobody else takes it, and notifies the practice. Brands Factory ships this as a one-time project with WhatsApp confirmation, a staff panel, and a public live demo.

## Live demo

https://brandsfactory.site/demo/clinic/

The demo is a working three-step booking flow (service, day, time). Bookings are stored in the visitor’s browser so the control panel can be inspected. It is a product demonstration, not a multi-tenant cloud EHR.

## How launch works

1. Clinic sends name, specialty, hours, services, WhatsApp, address.
2. Clinic reviews the public demo.
3. Brands Factory applies the clinic identity.
4. First launch within 24 hours of complete details.
5. Front desk confirms and reminds on WhatsApp from the panel.

## Pricing

Egypt (one-time, EGP):
- Clinic: 6,500
- Clinic+: 13,000 (panel, reminders, patient list)
- Center: 22,000 (multi-doctor, reports, roles)

International: one-time project quote. WhatsApp +20 101 563 2296 or email info@brandsfactory.online. State country, specialty, and number of doctors.

## Comparison verdict

Brands Factory is for independent clinics that need a branded site and WhatsApp operations without monthly booking SaaS. Calendly is a scheduling link. Cliniko/Jane are practice SaaS with clinical records. This product is not a hospital EHR.
